items.headline: RBI Holds Repo Rate Steady at 5.50%; Retail Inflation Rises to 4.38%
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India maintained its repo rates at 5.50% with a 'neutral' policy stance. The MPC revised its FY26 CPI inflation forecast down to 3.1%, but recent data showed India's retail inflation rose to 4.38% in June, exceeding the RBI's 4% target for the first time in 17 months, driven by fuel and food prices. The policy rate is expected to remain at 5.25% unless broader price pressures emerge.

items.headline: Global Markets Mixed as US Fed Holds Rates, Oil Prices Surge, and Middle East Tensions Escalate
items.summary: Global markets present a mixed picture. The US Federal Reserve's decision to keep benchmark interest rates unchanged eased some uncertainty, but US stocks sharply declined due to surging oil prices and escalating Middle East tensions. Asian markets are also mixed, digesting major technology firms' earnings, with Gift Nifty trends indicating a subdued start for the Indian benchmark index.

items.headline: IT and Metal Stocks Drive Indian Equity Benchmarks Higher
items.summary: Indian equity benchmarks ended strongly, primarily driven by gains in IT and metal stocks. The Nifty Smallcap 50 and Nifty Smallcap 100 indices outperformed. Infosys surged 4.51%, driving the Nifty IT index up 2.32%, and the Bank Nifty also added 0.79%, with private sector banks contributing positively. Auto, Realty, and REITs experienced mild profit booking.
